Here, I loaded up all my data from published spreadsheets I created. The data includes weekly attendance to NFL stadiums from 2015 to 2025. Each spreadsheet has the attendance to each stadium by week for each season.

Here, I combined all the spreadsheet and data into one object so it's easily accessible. I also switched the weeks attendance into columns rather than rows, so I was able to find the average attendance across a season for a specific team. 





```{r}
superbowl_winners <- tibble(
  Year = c(2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016, 2015),  # season years
  winner = c("Philadelphia Eagles", "Kansas City Chiefs","Kansas City Chiefs", "Los Angeles Rams", "Tampa Bay Buccaneers", "Kansas City Chiefs", "New England Patriots", "Philadelphia Eagles", "New England Patriots","Denver Broncos","New England Patriots") 
)

superbowl_winners <- superbowl_winners |>
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(Year))

nfl_attendance <- nfl_attendance |>
  mutate(season = as.numeric(season))

nfl_attendance <- nfl_attendance %>%
  left_join(superbowl_winners, by = c("season" = "Year"))
```



```{r}
superbowl_winners <- superbowl_winners |>
  mutate(next_season = Year + 1)
```

```{r}
defending_champs <- superbowl_winners |>
  select(next_season, winner) |>
  rename(season = next_season, defending_champ = winner)
```

```{r}
nfl_attendance <- nfl_attendance |>
  left_join(defending_champs, by = "season") |>
  mutate(is_defending_champ = Tm == defending_champ)
```

```{r}
team_season_avg <- nfl_attendance |>
  group_by(Tm, season) |>
  summarize(
    avg_attendance = mean(attendance, na.rm = TRUE),
    home_avg       = mean(attendance[str_detect(week, "Week")], na.rm = TRUE),
    is_defending_champ = any(is_defending_champ, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
team_season_avg <- team_season_avg |>
  arrange(Tm, season) |>
  group_by(Tm) |>
  mutate(
    prev_avg    = lag(avg_attendance),
    pct_change  = (avg_attendance - prev_avg) / prev_avg * 100
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
team_season_clean <- team_season_avg |>
  filter(!season %in% c(2020, 2021), !is.na(pct_change))

team_season_clean <- team_season_avg |>
  mutate(team = coalesce(Tm, "League Totals")) |>
  filter(!season %in% c(2020, 2021), !is.na(pct_change))
```

```{r}
champ_changes     <- team_season_clean |> filter(is_defending_champ == TRUE)  |> pull(pct_change)
non_champ_changes <- team_season_clean |> filter(is_defending_champ == FALSE) |> pull(pct_change)

cat("Defending champions — mean pct change:", round(mean(champ_changes), 2), "%\n")
cat("All other teams   — mean pct change:", round(mean(non_champ_changes), 2), "%\n")
cat("Number of defending-champion seasons:", length(champ_changes), "\n\n")

t.test(champ_changes, non_champ_changes)
```

```{r}
year_by_year_league_wide <- team_season_clean |> 
  filter(str_detect(team, "League Totals")) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x=season, y=avg_attendance)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x=season, y=avg_attendance), method="lm") +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Average Attendance"
  )
year_by_year_league_wide
```
